title: The Aeroplane, 5 Mar 1948, p.282: Zimmermann wind-tunnel results graphs (Figs. 17-18)
description: Magazine page featuring two aerodynamic graphs: "Fig. 17.—These results from Zimmermann's wind-tunnel tests on disc wings (1932) clearly show the characteristics of low aspect ratio aerofoils", plotting maximum lift, gliding angle and incidence against aspect ratio, and "Fig. 18.—Further results from Zimmermann's tests" plotting lift/drag ratio against aspect ratio for a Clark Y aerofoil section. Text sections include "Pancakes à la Zimmermann" and "An Italian 'Tortellino'"; ends "(To be continued.)".
